test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

One who reads a lot
solution: The correct answer is '**Bookworm**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Bookworm**'. • It means** 'a person who likes reading books very much'.** (पढ़ने में बहुत रुचि रखने वाला व्‍यक्ति; किताबी कीड़ा) • *Example: She's a bit of a **bookworm**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Bookworm.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Clever**: able to learn, understand or do something quickly and easily; intelligent. (चतुर, सयाना; बुद्धिमान) • **Witty**: clever and amusing; using words in a clever way. (चतुराईभरा और विनोदपूर्ण, मज़ेदार; वाक्‌चातुर्य प्रदर्शित करते हुए) • **Intelligent**: having or showing the ability to understand, learn and think; clever. (समझने, सीखने और सोचने की क्षमता से संपन्‍न, बुद्धिमान; चतुर) 31:T138e, The correct answer is **'at the airport'.**
